systems.name: Regional Rebound
systems.short: Three non-covers. A regional road trip.
systems.explain: Back the road team against the spread after three straight non-covers, traveling under 500 stadium-to-stadium miles.

systems.name: The 40-Point Hangover
systems.explain: Back a road underdog whose opponent allowed at least 40 points in its immediately previous completed game.

systems.name: Road Momentum
systems.short: Three straight covers. Latest win came away.
systems.explain: Back a team that covered its previous three games and won its most recent game on the road.

systems.name: After the Spotlight
systems.short: Opponent just beat a top-10 team.
systems.explain: Back a team facing an opponent that beat a top-10-ranked team in its immediately previous completed game.
